@@ -118,7 +118,7 @@
 * Fixed `BPTree.lca` returning wrong answers. With `i > j` it could return the wrong node, even for opening parentheses; given a node's closing parenthesis it could return a closing parenthesis rather than a node; and `lca(i, i)` returned the parent of a tip, reading past the end of the topology array for the root's closing parenthesis. Either parenthesis of a node now names it, the order of the two arguments does not matter, and a node is its own lowest common ancestor ([#2618](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2618)).
 * Fixed `BPTree.is_ancestor` treating a node as its own ancestor when the node was named by its closing parenthesis ([#2618](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2618)).
 * Fixed `BPTree` navigation in the two-node tree `(())`, a root with a single tip, where the range min-max tree's blocks held one parenthesis each, too few for its backward search. `first_child`, `last_child`, `count`, `height`, `is_ancestor`, `lca` and `preorder_rank` could give wrong answers; for example, the root's `last_child` was reported as none. Blocks now hold at least two parentheses ([#2618](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2618)).
-* Fixed `BPTree.minselect` with `q < 1` returning an occurrence counted from the end, through negative indexing. It now returns `None`, as for a `q` beyond the number of minima ([#2618](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2618)).
+* Fixed `BPTree.minselect` with `q < 1` returning an occurrence counted from the end, through negative indexing. It now returns -1, as for a `q` beyond the number of minima ([#2618](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2618), [#2638](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2638)).
 * Fixed `BPTree` failing to construct a single-node tree ([#2618](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2618)).
 * Fixed `BPTree`'s forward search reading past the end of its range min-max tree when a search starting in the last block of parentheses found nothing, e.g. for `level_next` of the root. The results were correct, but the read is undefined, and in a GPU kernel it can fault ([#2632](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2632)).
 * Fixed `BPTree.preorder_select` counting its ranks from 0, while `preorder_rank` counts from 1, so that it did not invert `preorder_rank` (given a node's rank, it returned the next node in preorder) and read past the end of the tree's index for the last node. Ranks now count from 1 for both, as for `postorder_rank` and `postorder_select`, and both selects return -1 for a rank outside 1 to the number of nodes rather than read outside the index. The asymmetry came from the layout of the select index inherited from improved-octo-waddle, which now holds the positions of each parenthesis with no leading entry ([#2632](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2632)).
@@ -133,6 +133,7 @@
 * Fixed `BPTree`'s Newick reader overflowing its buffer, or crashing, on valid trees with tips that have no label (e.g. `(,);`), and assigning the labels after such a tip to the wrong nodes (e.g. `(,b);` named the first tip `b`). A double quote (`"`) is now an ordinary character, as in the `TreeNode` reader, rather than a quote that could crash the reader, and input that is not a single tree, such as unbalanced parentheses or quotes, raises an error ([#2634](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2634)).
 * Fixed `BPTree`'s Newick reader taking `''` as an apostrophe only inside a fully quoted label: it now reads labels as the `TreeNode` reader does, e.g. `O''Brien` as `O'Brien` ([#2634](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2634)).
 * Fixed pickling and copying a `BPTree` losing its edge numbers ([#2634](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2634)).
+* Fixed `BPTree.mincount` and `BPTree.minselect` raising `ValueError`, or counting a negative position from the end, for a position outside the tree, and raising `ValueError` for an empty range (`i > j`). They now return -1 for a position outside the tree, as the other navigation methods and their Numba functions do, and 0 (`mincount`) or -1 (`minselect`) for an empty range ([#2638](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2638)).
